description: The plot illustrates the average repetition rate of relation categories in relation extraction tasks, comparing different configurations. The x-axis represents the relation categories, ranging from 0 to 60, and the y-axis shows the average repetition rate, ranging from 0.0 to 0.6. The blue line with circle markers represents the average repetition rate without DPO (Data Processing Optimization), the orange line with triangle markers represents the average repetition rate without DPO and without division hints, the green line with square markers represents the DPO, and the dashed blue line represents the average of the configurations without DPO and without division hints. The plot shows that the average repetition rate varies across different relation categories and configurations, with some peaks and declines observed.
